crossHostRecovery.title: Cross-host recovery
crossHostRecovery.description: A deployment across servers leaves a recovery checkpoint on them. Recovering that work after losing management needs a management backup taken inside the newest checkpoint’s window.
crossHostRecovery.loadFailed: Cross-host recovery could not be loaded.
crossHostRecovery.none: No checkpoint yet. The first deployment across servers takes one.
crossHostRecovery.window: Recovery can use a management backup taken after {{date}}.
crossHostRecovery.whole: This checkpoint was taken by an earlier release and carries all applied history, so it doesn’t limit which management backup recovery can use.
crossHostRecovery.short: This window is shorter than the 35 days of management backups the documentation suggests keeping, because this workspace’s applied history is busy. Keep a backup newer than {{date}}.
